conceptZh: 玩具機器人的手臂一長一短，筆畫躲貓貓，最後短褲出現。
object: a boxy toy robot and strokes that play peek-a-boo
morph: glyph strokes peek from the edges then settle into 短
creativeAngle: 一長一短的機器人手臂追著從邊緣探出頭的筆畫，最後穿上短褲。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a warm apricot backdrop. Lead: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts with one long arm and one stubby arm. The finished glyph 短 is a saturated royal-blue, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the robot reaches with the long arm for a blue stroke; it hops out of reach to the top edge. First "短" as he swings the stubby arm at nothing.
1.6-3.2s: hide-and-peek: strokes peek in from the left, right and bottom, ducking when he turns, once pulling him by the long arm; he spins in circles. Second "短" lands as he stops and plays dead, and the strokes tiptoe toward him.
3.2-5.0s: he grabs both with long and short arms; they click together as the glyph 短.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "短褲" a small pair of bright shorts drops onto his legs, too tight; he looks down, wiggles his hips and does a tiny dance, long arm waving, stubby arm waving shorter, clear of the strokes.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "短、短、短褲" (ㄉㄨㄢˇ、ㄉㄨㄢˇ、ㄉㄨㄢˇ ㄎㄨˋ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 短.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 布忍者想躲在一排由高到矮的藍色毛氈板後面，煙霧彈引線太短提早爆開，他嚇得撞倒第一塊板子，整排板子像骨牌一個接一個越倒越快，倒下的板子翻起來排成「短」字，最後一塊把他彈到半空，他落地後舉起短短的小刀比讚。
object: a row of standing royal-blue felt bars that get shorter and shorter from left to right, plus a tiny felt ninja with a smoke bomb whose fuse is far too short
morph: the ninja's early smoke-bomb pop makes him bump the tallest bar; the bars topple in a domino chain, each falling bar flipping up and snapping into place as a stroke, building 矢 on the left then 豆 on the right until 短 is complete, and the last bar catapults the ninja clear of the glyph
creativeAngle: 改用骨牌連鎖的大型實體笑點取代前版的躲貓貓與靜態量身高：由高到矮的板子本身就演出「越來越短」，忍者藏不住、煙霧彈太早爆的個性直接觸發連鎖，筆畫由撞擊甩出成形而非自己飛來；詞彙改為最安全的「短短」，用忍者得意舉起的小短刀讓聲音和畫面同一件事。
promptEn:
An 8-second stylized stop-motion-look animated clip on a soft pale-butter background, nothing else behind. Lead: a palm-sized felt ninja, round body, black felt hood with huge eager stitched eyes, a tiny red scarf, stubby arms and legs. He is sure nobody can see him and is always wrong. The finished glyph 短 (left component 矢, right component 豆) is solid saturated royal-blue felt, centered, about 70% of frame height with clear margins, every stroke correctly shaped and separate.

0.0-1.5s: A row of royal-blue felt bars stands on end along the floor from left to right, each one shorter than the last, the final one barely ankle high. The ninja tiptoes in from the left holding a round felt smoke bomb with a fuse only a fingernail long, already sparkling. He ducks behind the shortest bar; his whole head and shoulders stick out above it. He freezes, certain he is hidden. First "短" is spoken here as he crouches behind the too-short bar.

1.5-3.0s: He frowns at the tiny bar, scurries left and squeezes behind the tallest bar, peeking out with a proud grin. Poof: the short fuse burns out instantly and the smoke bomb pops in a fluffy grey puff. He leaps straight up in surprise and his bottom bonks the tallest bar.

3.0-4.6s: The tallest bar tips, taps the next, and the chain races left to right, faster and faster with soft felt thuds. Each bar that falls flips up and snaps into place in the air as a stroke: the left bars build 矢, the right bars build 豆. The second "短" lands as the strokes click into their final positions and the character 短 stands complete.

4.6-5.2s: The last stubby bar flips like a springboard and catapults the ninja in a slow somersault over the glyph. He lands on his feet on the floor at the lower right, well clear of the strokes, wobbles with a dizzy cross-eyed grin, then gives a surprised thumbs-up to camera.

5.2-8.0s: HOLD. The glyph 短 stays perfectly still, centered and fully readable. At "短短" the ninja proudly draws his sword, which turns out to be a tiny stubby felt blade no longer than his hand; he holds it high, waggles it, and a last little smoke puff escapes from his pocket. He stays in the lower-right margin and never touches the strokes.

Audio: an off-screen voice, warm and friendly, in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct with clear tones, reading exactly "短、短、短短" (ㄉㄨㄢˇ、ㄉㄨㄢˇ、ㄉㄨㄢˇ ㄉㄨㄢˇ): the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. Only soft felt thuds, one gentle pop and a faint boing under the voice. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 短. No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
